title: Left Caret Air Intake & S-Duct
summary: Fixed-geometry diamond/caret supersonic air inlet and serpentine S-duct feeding the left F119 engine while hiding the compressor face from frontal radar.
role: Decelerates supersonic airflow efficiently without moving ramps and shields engine fan blades for low observability.
materials: Composite ducting with radar-absorbent internal liner (public overview).
